analyst.summary: Narayana Hrudayalaya's headline revenue growth of 78% this quarter looks spectacular, but most of it comes from newly consolidated UK hospital operations rather than genuine same-market momentum - the core India business, still about half of revenue, grew a healthier but far more modest 17%. Profit grew only about 6% even as revenue jumped 78%, because the newly added international business carries thinner margins and integration costs. This is a fundamentally sound, expanding hospital group, but the eye-catching growth number should not be read as organic strength, and margins will need to recover as the new geography matures.
